_comment: R32 for C1: one single-edit mutant per invariant this task's cases claim, in the five areas the brief names — tenant binding, role check, limit bound, cursor MAC, projection — plus the suspension gate and the filter/field allowlists the same boundary owns. `node tests/c/run-mutants.mjs` applies each to a temporary copy of the console and requires a case the mutant DECLARES to fail on an assertion; the cases come from the exported conformance functions run against C1's services and from this track's own tests. A claimed invariant with no mutant, or a mutant with no case, is the defect this list exists to prevent.
